prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic artistic interpretation of Gran Vía in Madrid, Spain, at night, with all signage and lettering removed: completely blank façades with no signs, no brand names, no letters anywhere. The Edificio Metrópolis dome with its plain dome, the Carrión Building with its blank circular rooftop neon ring, theatre lights and warm streetlamps lighting the avenue. Historic early-20th-century buildings on both sides, street lamps casting warm light on the roadway. No identifiable people prominent. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere, no on-image text at all.
